analyst_view.overall: Early view: Sporting are seventh under Nicolás Larcamón but lost 2-1 at home to Valladolid, had a long injury list before that game, and an earlier report said the board was backing him despite concern about the start of the season. Granada have won five in a row under Pacheta and have a good away record (four wins in seven). Juan Otero's red-card ban should be served by this date unless it is a long one.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.6 goals. Sporting's home games have averaged about two goals and Granada's away games nearly three, which averages out close to the site's number.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.2 corners. I lean slightly higher: Sporting won nine corners against Valladolid with 62% of the ball, and Granada are happy to sit back away and look for set pieces.

cards.text: The numbers say 5.2 cards. I lean higher: Sporting had four or five yellows and a straight red against Valladolid at El Molinón, and they will be under pressure to respond against a team in form.

shots.text: The numbers say 26.5 shots. Sporting took 20 against Valladolid, while Granada won at Eldense with only eight, so the total looks about right.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 9.1 shots on target. I lean slightly lower: Granada win games with few shots on goal, and Sporting put six on target against Valladolid.
